subject: Re: [AMBER] Looking for a force field with ester linkages between protein chains permitted.

messages.author: FyD
messages.body:
Dear David,
> Unable to find a standard force field which will accommodate ester
> linkage of domains..
See
https://upjv.q4md-forcefieldtools.org/Tutorial/Tutorial-4.php
https://upjv.q4md-forcefieldtools.org/Tutorial/Tutorial-4.php#SpltV
(an ester linkage is similar to the phosphodiester linkage in nucleic
acids from a charge derivation point of view)
Best Francois
